answer_1.quote: We conduct experiments on ... long-context tasks ... including Single-Doc QA, Multi-Doc QA, and Summarization ...

answer_2.quote: We use GPT-4o to automatically rate the models' responses ... we also use FactScore to evaluate faithfulness.

answer_3.quote: LongReward utilizes an off-the-shelf LLM M judge to provide reward signals for long-context-based model responses ...

answer_4.quote: Human evaluation further validates that LongReward has good alignment with human preference ... we report the proportion of wins, ties, and losses of the DPO model on each dimension.
answer_4.guideline: evaluate model responses on dimensions such as helpfulness, logicality, faithfulness, and completeness
